name: fitsync
description: FITSYNC — AI Personal Wardrobe & Stylist Platform

scripts.server:check: npm --prefix server run build --dry-run 2>/dev/null || (cd server && npx tsc --noEmit)
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.build: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.typecheck: cd server && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../client && npx tsc -b
